name: Pakistan
about: Summer (May–Sep) is the only real window for the high Karakoram — K2 Base Camp and the northern passes; winter is bitterly cold and many roads become impassable.
overview: K2, the Karakoram range, the Hunza Valley, and the Karakoram Highway — a great high-altitude trekking destination, less crowded than Nepal.
costOverview: One of the best-value serious trekking destinations on Earth — everyday food and transport are cheap, and even the multi-week K2 Base Camp trek costs far less than comparable trips in Nepal.
